segments.name: Sleep and Breathing Health
segments.description: Designs and sells cloud-connected devices, masks and accessories for sleep apnea, ventilation and other sleep and breathing disorders.
segments.evidence: CPAP systems deliver pressurized air, typically through a mask, to prevent collapse of the upper airway during sleep.

segments.name: Residential Care Software
products: business management software and service solutions
segments.description: Provides business management software and service solutions, including Brightree, to healthcare providers in residential care settings.
segments.evidence: Our Residential Care Software solutions are sold to providers of healthcare in various residential care settings.

revenueModel.text: Patients, home healthcare providers and residential care providers pay ResMed for devices, masks, software and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: In Germany, Australia, New Zealand, and South Korea, we also operate home healthcare businesses, providing products and services directly to patients through a vertically integrated network.
